observation.visible_scene: A top-down close view of a cream/white long-pile shaggy rug. Lying in the center is an irregular patch with a pale tan background covered in dark brown/black spots (leopard-like or porous texture). Across the patch, small bright orange glowing spots appear intermittently at varying locations. The overall framing of the rug and the patch stays essentially constant throughout the segment.
visible_changes: The orange glowing spots flicker: they appear, fade, and shift to different positions on the patch from frame to frame (e.g., lower-left in frame 1, upper-right in frame 2, a vertical streak at left-center in frame 15, mid-left bright spot in frame 26, top/center in frames 40-41). Their intensity and location are not fixed.
The spotted patch itself remains in approximately the same position, size, and orientation across the excerpt; no clear translation, rotation, or large deformation is visible.
The surrounding fluffy rug shows no motion; its texture and the patch's placement relative to the frame edges are stable.
The visible outline of the patch changes slightly frame to frame, but this tracks the flickering orange spots and overlapping rug fibers rather than a real reshaping of the patch.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the orange spots are small flames, sparks, or bright reflections, and what produces them.
Any onset or cessation of the flickering outside this cropped window (it is already active at the first frame and still active at the last).
The true material/identity of the spotted patch and the rug.
uncertain_details: Minor apparent positional drift of the patch between early and late frames is too small to attribute confidently to object motion versus slight camera jitter; the camera is treated as essentially static.
The nature of the orange spots (combustion vs. reflection) cannot be determined from the images alone.
Subtle changes in the patch boundary may be occlusion by rug fibers rather than deformation.
